name: Default AoE Spam Hitter
dsl: ?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) | any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>]
description: Just spams enchanted AoE damage attacks. Best used on high-level wizards farming low-level content, or in large teams where fast kills are easy.
